reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Integrated approach toward malaria elimination in foci 1A, 1B and 1C

description.narrative: Guyana - Malaria - Ministry of Health of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana - MOH. This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria cases by 75% by the year 2025 against a 2015 baseline. To reduce the malaria mortality rate by 75% by the year 2025 against a 2015 baseline. To eliminate P. falciparum malaria from all regions by 2025. To eliminate malaria from Foci 8B, 9A and 9C by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen national and regional capacities in programme management. To improve the delivery and quality of facility-based services in the public and private sectors, and expand community-based services. To strengthen malaria surveillance and monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems across all levels to facilitate effective planning and decision-making specifically among vulnerable groups. To reduce host-vector contact by increasing use of personal protection and reducing transmission through Integrated Vector Management (IVM). To strengthen IEC, SBCC, and advocacy efforts to increase uptake of malaria prevention and risk reduction behaviors, and mobilize additional resources for malaria
